checks: exact unrestricted mode: compare all returned partitions against the direct RGS oracle
certificate success: compare q=2 full partition set and independently check projections and negative rejection
certificate abstention: preserve insufficient_coverage and exit 4
hybrid fallback: compare q=2 solution set against the direct oracle and require insufficient-coverage trigger
zero deadline: require incomplete, exit 3, and no fallback trigger
invalid q and contradictory labels: require invalid_input, exit 2
capture: Capture this protocol and driver, solver.py, public CLI and provider sources, and every fixture before invoking the root CLI.
performance: Correctness checks only; no timing or memory measurements.
